annotations.title: Create or edit an Instagram DM automation

description: Create (no id) or edit (id) an automation that DMs people automatically: a comment with a keyword on one post / the next post / any post gets a private reply, or a DM / story reply / ig.me link gets an answer. Optional link buttons, public comment replies, follow gate and dry run. Once per person per post; Meta allows private replies within 7 days of the comment. It DMs real people, so confirm the text first. Free, no AI on the send path.

account.description: @handle or id of the Instagram account; omit when only one is connected

cooldownHours.description: DM/story/ref rules: answer one person at most once per this many hours (default 24)

dryRun.description: log what would be sent without sending

enabled.description: false pauses the automation without deleting it

followGate.description: send the content only to followers: they tap a button first

ask.description: message asking the person to follow the account

button.description: label of the button the person taps once they follow

enabled.description: true = non-followers see the follow prompt before the content

notFollowing.description: message sent to someone who does not follow yet

id.description: rule id to edit; omit to create a new automation

message.description: what the person receives: {text, buttons}; up to 3 link buttons

name.description: name of the automation, shown in the list

publicReplies.description: comment rules: public replies under the comment, rotated (e.g. "Sent! Check your DMs")

trigger.description: what starts the rule: {type, keywords, match, scope, ...}; keywords are case-insensitive

keywords.description: case-insensitive words/phrases; empty = any comment/story reply (DM rules need one)

match.description: contains (keyword appears in the text) or exact (whole text must equal the keyword)

mediaId.description: the post for scope "post" (list_instagram_media gives ids)

mediaType.description: scope "next": only the next reel, or only the next feed post

ref.description: ref rules: the ref in ig.me/m/<handle>?ref=<ref>

scope.description: comment rules: one post (mediaId), the NEXT post you publish, or every post

type.description: comment (keyword on a post comment), dm (keyword in a DM), story_reply, or ref (ig.me link)

name: save_instagram_dm_automation
title: Create or edit an Instagram DM automation
